GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 311 (9 Sep 47) CCS
(SCAPIN - 1771/4)
APO 500
19 July 1949
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Relaxation of International Telecommunications Restrictions.
1. Reference is made to memoranda for the Japanese Government as follows:
a. File AG 311.5 (18 Dec 45)SC, SCAPIN 456, dated 18 December 1945, subject: Permission to Use Code Books for Communications.
b. File AG 311 (9 Sep 47)CCS, SCAPIN 1771, dated 9 September 1947, subject: Relaxation of International Telecommunications Restrictions.
2. Effective immediately, SCAPIN 456 is rescinded. Pursuant to paragraph 2, SCAPIN 1771, all languages, codes, or ciphers admitted by country of destination may be used in telegrams originating in Japan.
3. Direct communication between the Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the Ministry of Telecommunications, regarding matters within the scope of this memorandum, is authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
